title: Agents and agentic workflows
summary: Agentic systems designed, connected, kept running, measured and constrained: agent architectures, MCP (both angles), durable orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, LLMOps.
intro: This module covers how agentic systems are designed, connected to other systems, kept running through failures, measured, and constrained. It moves from agent architectures, frameworks and SDK primitives through the Model Context Protocol (the concepts and the building of MCP servers) and durable orchestration to evaluation, guardrails and LLMOps, which includes evals, tracing and AI-assisted development with Claude Code and Cursor. These are the parts that decide whether an agentic deployment survives contact with production.
